automatic_prior: original degraded alpha, uncertain at every pixel including endpoints
user_constraints: assisted_human_labels_v1: the replay's rasterized 0/128/255 label plane, applied as exact hard constraints
user_constraint_source: core/src/assisted_replay.rs label_plane over the reconstructed active stroke set; the app is the only writer and the core the only reader
energy: independent overlapping local alpha^T L alpha + prior_weight * sum((alpha-prior)^2)
prior_weight_reason: unchanged from the tiled_soft_prior_v2 declaration; this run changes the constraints, not the kernel
kernel_choice_reason: owner decision 2: the global estimate_soft_prior refuses every subset extent at MAX_UNKNOWN_PIXELS=500000, the tiled kernel ran all 90 V2 cases inside the 2GiB harness, and closed_form_matting::estimate_input_job copies labeled pixels verbatim so human labels are exact; V3 protection is a recorded failed hypothesis, V4 estimates nothing and V5 is not the guided path
assembly: copy each native-resolution tile center without blending or resampling
max_iterations: min(500, floor((20000000000 / (25 * sum(all tile pixels including repeated halos)) - 3) / 5))
any_unconverged_tile: refuse complete image, no partial success
implementation: shared existing local Laplacian and PCG, bounded full-resolution tiles, unchanged from tiled_soft_prior_v2
fixtures: the declared 36-case assisted completion subset (24 photographic crops, 12 complete photographic cases); the analytic corpus is not scored by this path
solver_inputs: workspace cases/<anon>/source.png, cases/<anon>/prior.png and replays/<anon>.json only; every declared PNG and plane hash is re-checked before the solve
reference_use: metrics only, after the workspace source and prior are proved byte-for-byte equal to frozen::photo_source and frozen::prior
gates: unchanged phase-6-matting-reference-protocol thresholds, re-scored by scripts/phase9i_gate_v2_rescore.py under gate v2
replay_admission: final only; human origin with scoreable and a source_only blinding attestation; matching case id, workspace id, dimensions, four displayed-asset hashes and task card; a recorded label plane; every per-event label-plane hash reproduced
refusal_semantics: a missing, malformed, unscoreable or hash-failed replay is a scored refusal record in the denominator, never a skipped case
exposure: a declared-exposed case is scored and counted, and listed under exposed
resources: unchanged per-solve 500000 unknown and 1000000 active-window caps; entire tiled call <=20000000000 stencil terms, 256*full_image_pixels+64MiB under the 2GiB harness
